description: Battanian dark green knee-length wool tunic over cream linen, with gold knotwork woven borders at neckline, cuffs, front and hem. A broad decorated brown leather belt with round metal buckle and an ornamented hanging end secures the waist. A green wool cloak with gold knotwork borders and fringed edges drapes across the shoulders, fastened by a large round ornate brooch. Brown trousers, wrapped lower legs and brown leather shoes complete the outfit.
